@@ -1,8 +1,29 @@
+' =============================================================================
+'CHECK_INPUT
+' =============================================================================
+DIM gKeyPressed AS BYTE : GLOBAL gKeyPressed
+
+PROC check_key_swi
+    ON CPU6809 BEGIN ASM
+        SWI
+        FCB   $0C          ; KBSTAT - non bloccante
+        BCC   CK_NONE      ; C=0 = nessun tasto
+        STB   _gKeyPressed ; salva ASCII del tasto in variabile ugBASIC
+        BRA   CK_DONE
+CK_NONE:
+        CLR   _gKeyPressed
+CK_DONE:
+    END ASM ON CPU6809
+END PROC
+
 CLS
-gKeyPressed = 0
 
+
+
+
 DO
+    CALL check_key_swi 
     IF gKeyPressed <> 0 THEN
 
         PRINT "KEY PRESSED: ";HEX$(gKeyPressed)
         gKeyPressed = 0
